answer: The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in ledge, expire in signal, and anchor lists each expiry. Anyone running 143 aliases therefore needs 118 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4265 identities would post 711 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
